articles.title: India and US Hold High-Level Nuclear Talks in Washington as IAEA Launches Maritime Reactor Initiative
articles.excerpt: Atomic Energy Commission Chairman Ajit Kumar Mohanty met US Energy Secretary Chris Wright to discuss bilateral civil nuclear cooperation, as India joined 27 nations in launching the IAEA's ATLAS initiative for nuclear-powered ships.
articles.nri_angle: Deepening US-India nuclear ties create opportunities for Indian-American professionals and companies in the growing nuclear sector, while ATLAS initiative could reshape global maritime energy.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Australia Sends Aid as Indian-Origin Australians Among 39 Missing in Nepal Floods
articles.excerpt: Many of the missing Australians are Indian-origin pilgrims headed to Mount Kailash when the catastrophic flood struck the Nepal-Tibet border.
articles.nri_angle: At least 15 of the 39 missing Australians are Indian-Australians on a Kailash Mansarovar pilgrimage. Indian-origin communities across Australia are holding vigils. Isha Foundation reports 77 pilgrims and 3 staff missing.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India and Canada Launch Economic Dialogue, Signal Readiness for Investment Treaty Talks
articles.excerpt: Finance Ministers Nirmala Sitharaman and François-Philippe Champagne concluded the inaugural India-Canada Economic and Financial Dialogue in Toronto, setting an aspiration to expand bilateral trade to CAD 70 billion by 2030.
articles.nri_angle: UPI integration in Canada could lower remittance costs for 1.8 million Indian-origin Canadians; investment treaty and CEPA would strengthen economic ties for diaspora entrepreneurs.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indians Lead UK Visa, Settlement, and Citizenship Numbers Across All Major Routes
articles.excerpt: Official UK government data shows Indian nationals account for nearly one in five visas issued, top the list for work-based settlement, and rank first for British citizenship grants among non-EU nationalities.
articles.nri_angle: Indians dominate nearly every legal immigration pathway to the UK, from work visas to citizenship, reflecting the diaspora's deep integration into British professional and economic life.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: PSU Employee Earning ₹23 Lakh Reveals Why Government Jobs Still Beat MNC Offers
articles.excerpt: A public sector employee's viral social media post detailing free housing, fuel, and electricity — with monthly expenses under ₹15,000 — has reignited the debate over whether PSU perks outweigh private sector salaries.
articles.image_caption: A public sector undertaking in India. An employee earning ₹23 lakh annually explains why government jobs continue to offer advantages over private sector MNC positions.
articles.nri_angle: The PSU-versus-private debate resonates strongly with NRIs weighing return-to-India career options, where take-home value often matters more than headline salary.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian Student Applications to US Undergraduate Programs Drop 15% Amid Visa Crackdown
articles.excerpt: A Common App report shows Indian applicants fell sharply in 2025-26 as tighter immigration rules, a proposed $100,000 OPT fee, and four-year visa caps push families toward alternative destinations.
articles.image_caption: Students walk across a U.S. university campus. Indian student applications to American undergraduate programs have dropped 15 percent amid tighter visa enforcement.
articles.nri_angle: Directly impacts Indian families considering US undergraduate education for their children — covers application declines, visa policy changes, OPT fee proposals, and the shift toward alternative destinations
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Kangana Ranaut Fires Back at Baba Ramdev Over 'Generation Gutter' Criticism
articles.excerpt: BJP MP accuses yoga guru of crossing 'every boundary of decency' as their war of words intensifies over her controversial remarks about Gen Z protesters.
articles.image_caption: Kangana Ranaut at a public event. The actor and BJP MP hit back at yoga guru Baba Ramdev after he criticised her generation as morally decadent.
articles.nri_angle: Both Kangana Ranaut and Baba Ramdev are widely recognized figures across the Indian diaspora; the generational values debate has resonated on NRI social media
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian-Origin UC Santa Cruz Student Dies After Car Plunges Off California Cliff
articles.excerpt: Alli R. Singh, 19, a psychology major, was killed when the vehicle she was riding in went off West Cliff Drive near the iconic Steamer Lane surf break and landed in the ocean.
articles.nri_angle: An Indian-origin university student in California was killed in a tragic car crash, highlighting the personal losses that reverberate across the diaspora community.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Gujarati Store Owner Shot Dead During Armed Robbery in Tennessee
articles.excerpt: Suresh Patel, 56, from Mehsana was killed at his Jackson liquor store while his 19-year-old daughter witnessed the attack; the masked suspect remains at large.
articles.nri_angle: The killing of a Gujarati store owner in Tennessee extends a pattern of violent crimes against Indian-origin small-business owners across the United States.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Who Is Sal Khan? The Son of Immigrants From India and Bangladesh Who Became the World's Teacher — and Is Now Building a $10,000 AI College
articles.excerpt: From tutoring his cousin on a Yahoo notepad to launching a college backed by Google and Microsoft, Sal Khan turned a free education mission into a global movement.
articles.image_caption: Sal Khan speaking at a TED conference. The Khan Academy founder has become one of the most influential educators in the world, with his free platform reaching tens of millions of learners across 190 countries.
articles.nri_angle: Bengali-origin American educator whose platform reaches millions worldwide; received India's Padma Shri; now launching affordable AI college degree
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Goyal Leads 200-Member Business Delegation to Japan, Pitches India as $30 Trillion Partner
articles.excerpt: Commerce Minister targets 10 trillion yen in Japanese investment over the next decade across AI, semiconductors, and clean energy as bilateral trade hits $27.5 billion.
articles.image_caption: Indian Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal. He is leading a 200-member business delegation to Japan to pitch India as a key economic partner.
articles.nri_angle: Deepening India-Japan economic ties create opportunities for diaspora professionals and businesses in both countries across manufacturing, technology, and infrastructure sectors.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Khawaja Asif Challenges Mohsin Naqvi to Fix Pakistan From Within Before Demanding System Overhaul
articles.excerpt: Pakistan's Defence Minister fires back at Interior Minister's call for governance 'hard reset,' urging him to implement the National Action Plan and reform cricket first.
articles.image_caption: Pakistani politician Khawaja Asif. He has publicly challenged Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi to address domestic issues before calling for broader systemic reform.
articles.nri_angle: Pakistan’s governance crisis and its contrast with India’s trajectory is closely followed by the Indian diaspora interested in South Asian geopolitics.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Former Meta Manager Sues Company, Claims He Was Fired for Refusing to Sign Immigration Letter
articles.excerpt: James Tillinghast alleges Meta terminated him after he declined to endorse an EB-2 National Interest Waiver petition that he says contained materially inaccurate claims about an employee's contributions.
articles.nri_angle: The lawsuit spotlights the EB-2 National Interest Waiver process used by thousands of Indian tech workers in the U.S. and raises questions about how major employers handle immigration sponsorship claims.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Bank Unions Signal Indefinite Strike Over 5-Day Week, PLI, and Pension Demands
articles.excerpt: The United Forum of Bank Unions escalates its agitation after the government fails to implement a five-day work week agreed in the 2024 wage settlement, with PLI and pension updation adding to the standoff.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs who rely on Indian public sector banks for NRO/NRE accounts and cross-border transactions face service disruptions during strikes, while the broader standoff signals unresolved labour tensions in India's banking sector.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Why a Rs 1-2 Lakh Salary in India's Tier-1 Cities No Longer Buys Financial Freedom
articles.excerpt: Rising housing costs, school fees, and lifestyle inflation are trapping India's urban middle class in a cycle of high income but minimal wealth accumulation.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs comparing their overseas incomes to what peers earn back home may overestimate the purchasing power of India salaries, while those considering returning face the same cost-of-living squeeze.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: UK MP Tanmanjeet Singh Dhesi Pushes for NRI Reforms and Direct Flights in Punjab Visit
articles.excerpt: The three-time Slough MP and UK Defence Committee chair met Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann to discuss aviation connectivity, NRI property disputes, extortion threats, and the Kartarpur Corridor.
articles.image_caption: UK Labour MP Tanmanjeet Singh Dhesi. Dhesi visited Punjab to push for NRI-friendly reforms including direct flights and dual citizenship recognition.
articles.nri_angle: UK Labour MP Dhesi raises NRI property disputes, direct UK-Punjab flights, extortion threats, and Kartarpur Corridor reopening with Punjab CM and ministers during multi-day visit.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: NRI Investments Surge Into GIFT City as Edelweiss Launches India's First Multi-Manager Fund
articles.excerpt: Fund commitments at India's international financial hub nearly doubled to $15.74 billion, with retail investor participation tripling as new products simplify cross-border investing for overseas Indians.
articles.image_caption: Radhika Gupta, MD and CEO of Edelweiss Mutual Fund, speaks about the company's GIFT City strategy. Edelweiss has launched India's first multi-manager equity fund from the international financial hub, targeting NRI and OCI investors.
articles.nri_angle: Edelweiss launches first multi-manager fund from GIFT City targeting NRIs and OCIs, as the hub's total fund commitments surge 87% to $15.74 billion with retail investor participation nearly tripling.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Modi Pledges 'New Arsenal of Reforms' at ET World Leaders Forum as India Eyes 20% of Global Growth
articles.excerpt: At The Economic Times summit in New Delhi, the Prime Minister highlighted India's 90% economic expansion over a decade and outlined plans for sweeping policy changes across sectors.
articles.image_caption: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addresses The Economic Times World Leaders Forum 2026 in New Delhi. Modi outlined plans for sweeping economic reforms and highlighted India's sustained growth trajectory.
articles.nri_angle: Modi's reform agenda and India's sustained growth trajectory have direct implications for NRI investors and diaspora professionals watching India's economic transformation.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: California Prepares to Celebrate Its First Diwali as an Official State Holiday
articles.excerpt: Assembly Bill 268 makes California the third U.S. state to recognize the festival of lights, giving nearly 900,000 Indian Americans a new marker of cultural inclusion.
articles.image_caption: Diwali lamps arranged during a festival celebration. California will observe Diwali as an official state holiday for the first time on November 8, 2026.
articles.nri_angle: California's nearly 900,000 Indian Americans gain formal state-level recognition of Diwali, the most important holiday celebrated by the diaspora.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: "Talent Is Universal, Opportunity Is Not": Wadhwani Foundation CEO Dr. Ajay Kela on Why the Diaspora's Greatest Asset Isn't Money
articles.excerpt: In an exclusive interview with The Videshi, the CEO of Wadhwani Foundation talks about India's innovation ecosystem, the "missing middle" of Indian entrepreneurship, and why the diaspora's most powerful currency isn't capital — it's knowledge.
articles.image_caption: Dr. Ajay Kela, CEO and Board Member of Wadhwani Foundation, leads the organization's mission to create 5 million jobs and upskill 25 million people across emerging economies.
articles.nri_angle: Interview with Dr. Ajay Kela, NRI leader who returned to India to lead Wadhwani Foundation — covers diaspora giving back, deep-tech opportunities, and India's innovation ecosystem.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: The Goan OCI Struggle: How a Bureaucratic Catch-22 Left Thousands in Limbo
articles.excerpt: Goans who acquired Portuguese citizenship for EU access found their Indian passports revoked and their path to Overseas Citizen of India status blocked by a paperwork gap — a problem only partially resolved by a 2024 policy fix.
articles.nri_angle: Goan diaspora across Portugal, UK, Gulf states, and East Africa face ongoing obstacles to OCI status despite policy fixes; relevant to all NRIs navigating India's overseas citizenship framework
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Annapurni Subramaniam Becomes First Indian Woman to Win COSPAR Vikram Sarabhai Medal
articles.excerpt: The astrophysicist and IIA director was honored at the 46th COSPAR Scientific Assembly in Florence for her pioneering contributions to space research and India's AstroSat mission.
articles.image_caption: Annapurni Subramaniam, Director of the Indian Institute of Astrophysics, became the first Indian woman to receive the prestigious COSPAR Vikram Sarabhai Medal.
articles.nri_angle: Subramaniam's recognition at the highest levels of international space research underscores the depth of talent from Indian scientific institutions, resonating with diaspora scientists worldwide.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Aisha Wahab Becomes First Afghan American in Congress After Winning California Special Election
articles.excerpt: The progressive California state senator defeats Melissa Hernandez to succeed Eric Swalwell, overcoming nearly $4.4 million in AIPAC-aligned spending.
articles.image_caption: Aisha Wahab, who became the first Afghan American elected to the U.S. Congress after winning a California special election.
articles.nri_angle: Wahab's victory is a landmark for South Asian and Muslim American political representation, extending the growing influence of diaspora communities in U.S. elections.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: RFK Jr.'s Son Conor Kennedy Placed on Russia's Wanted List Over Ukraine Service
articles.excerpt: A Moscow court authorized the arrest in absentia of the 32-year-old Kennedy scion, who secretly fought for Ukraine's International Legion in 2022 and now faces up to 10 years in a Russian prison.
articles.nri_angle: The case highlights the legal risks facing foreign volunteers in the Russia-Ukraine war, relevant to diaspora communities with members who have considered or participated in international military service.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: BNP Veteran Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir Elected as Bangladesh's 23rd President
articles.excerpt: The 78-year-old former BNP secretary general won a decisive parliamentary vote, marking the first contested presidential election in Bangladesh in 35 years.
articles.nri_angle: Bangladesh's political transition under BNP leadership reshapes diplomatic and trade dynamics across South Asia, with implications for the significant Bangladeshi diaspora community.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
